findings.description: The implementation rounds to the nearest cent by adding 1 only when remainder > 5, which means that when remainder == 5 (exact half-cent), it does not round up. This violates the requirement that exact half-cent ties are rounded upward.
findings.evidence: For example, cents(5) returns 0, but it should return 1.

review.summary: Candidate implementation fails to round exact half-cent ties upward, violating the rounding specification.
